ownership_reason: Only the gold decides which child nodes are data nodes and where a run of adjacent data nodes ends; hops 1-3 pass the child list along unchanged and hop 4 joins, in order, the runs it receives. The gold's javadoc promises the runs of adjacent data nodes that the list holds; a script element whose only child is its data node holds one such run, and the gold returns none. The dropped nodes are in no run that reaches hop 4, so no caller above the gold can restore them from the gold's output. The convention that every data node of the child list is collected, the ones at its end included, is pinned outside the gold: Element.data() appends the data of every DataNode child in child order (HtmlParserTest handlesDataOnlyTags and preservesSpaceInScript, where the data node is the element's last and only child), and Element.textNodes(), the sibling filter on childNodes, keeps the trailing text node (ElementTest testGetTextNodes: " Four", the last child, is the third text node); the facade's own javadoc calls the method a filter on childNodes() to get Data nodes.
